notes: Resumed after the usage-limit pause: the saved commits (wp/WP-12 13f0c2b, 122ae28, 32ec85e on 350e3f8) were cherry-picked onto the integration tip 3a2c574 (only docs and workflow files changed between the two) and every acceptance check was re-run there; this report replaces the saved one. The worktree was created from main and its branch was reset to 3a2c574 before any work. Conduit routing (EXPERIENCE §4.1 gives only its size and "from the column base toward the grid"): it lies on the line from the column axis to the grid center, starts inside the column base and its far corner meets the left face of the first bar column, so the 0.24 m strip touches but never cuts a bar. Bar heights per set come from rng() with a seeded level, left-right trend and back-row rise plus per-bar variation, so the back rows show from the camera and no single bar stands out.
